reports.title: UroGen Reports $68.0 Million of ZUSDURI Revenue and Provides Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Highlights

lines: UroGen is updating its full-year 2026 net product revenue guidance for JELMYTO to approximately $90 million, compared with its prior guidance range of $97 million to $101 million.

The Company continues to expect full-year 2026 operating expenses to be in the range of $260 million to $270 million, with expenses anticipated toward the upper end of the range, including non-cash share-based compensation expense of $20 million to $24 million.
